description: Internal alterations involving the removal of existing partitions between- kitchen and dining room, front and rear sitting rooms at ground floor level, toilet and bathroom at first floor level; creation of new doorway opening to front first floor level bedroom (and 'blocking up' of existing doorway) and rear dressing room; installation of partition wall to landing (to create a shower room), installation of partition walls/ creation of openings at roof floor level; external alterations involving creation of opening between side wall of existing kitchen and dining room and rear wall of kitchen, associated with Ground floor rear 'infill' conservatory extension; ground floor rear 'bay' extension, with associated balustrade to flat roof (to serve first floor level balcony); replacement/ enlarged ground floor level side extension (following demolition of existing garage); installation of 'conservatory style' rooflight to side roofslope; external alterations involving rebuilding/ restoration of existing features and altered door/ window opening; replacement front boundary walls/ fencing, pedestrian and vehicular gates; and replacement rear boundary fence (application for Listed Building Consent)
